name: Scroll-Driven Carousel Dots
description: Step indicator dots that track a horizontally scroll-snapping carousel through a named CSS scroll progress timeline, with a gliding active dot plus a growing step-bar variant, all with zero JavaScript.
usage: Copy styles.css, wrap your slides in a .sdc > .sdc-track structure, set --sdc-slides on the .sdc wrapper to the slide count, and drop the .sdc-dots rail (one .sdc-dot per slide plus one .sdc-thumb) as the first child of the track. Swap the rail for a single .sdc-bar element to get the growing step-bar flavor instead.
